source: H04 build-35747 normal and golden Kangor card faces, cross-checked with historical-composite-nodes.json and historical-card-pool.json

reference_scope.history: record each friendly MECHANICAL or ALL death from combat start with an explicit death batch; only a strict one-mech-per-batch history is eligible
reference_scope.copy_state: copy combat attack and effective maximum health excluding current aura contributions, current keywords, race and normal/golden form; restore the copy to that health
reference_scope.position: insert the selected copies from the dead Kangor's former index in death-history order, up to seven board slots
reference_scope.repeat: one surviving friendly Baron repeats the same first-N selection twice or three times; Khadgar interaction is rejected
reference_scope.generated_manifest: new instance IDs keep the initial Kangor as lifecycle source and carry reference provenance; a token inherits its explicitly graded damage tier
reference_scope.reject: same-batch ties, a mech dying with Kangor, duplicate root death identities, unsupported copy state or generated deathrattle chains fail atomically
